Finished and Torrents cards, seeding you can stop and start, an upload limit that works, unpacking on the progress bar, and a Windows installer that keeps the desktop app up to date. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Finished and Torrents cards on the Downloads page.** A package that has downloaded and unpacked moves into Finished, a finished torrent into Torrents, where the Status column says whether it still seeds. Each card sorts, selects and folds on its own, and both can be switched off under Settings, Downloads.
- **Stop and start seeding by hand**, from the right-click menu or with the two buttons on the Torrents card's edge. A stopped torrent stays stopped after a restart. A started one seeds to the targets again, counted from the moment you start it. Scripts use `POST /api/tasks/seeding/stop` and `/start`.
- **The progress bar shows unpacking.** While an archive unpacks, the bars of its parts and its package fill with the unpacking, striped so it does not look like a download, and a failed unpacking stays red where it stopped. Another instance's list shows it too.
- **A torrent's files show under its row**, each with its size, progress and a switch. Switching files while the torrent downloads changes what it fetches and keeps what is already here.
- **A Windows installer** beside each zip. It installs for everyone under Program Files and leaves your settings, accounts and JDownloader in `%APPDATA%\KnightLoader` alone, also when uninstalling.
- **The desktop app updates itself.** It downloads a new release in the background, checks it against `checksums.txt` and starts it the next time you open KnightLoader. The installed copy is updated by a scheduled task called KnightLoader Update. The switch is on the General page of Settings.
- **Captchas over the phrase.** The phone app answers reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile when it is connected with the phrase. It shows them under the address of the hoster's page, so they run as they would in a browser on that site.

## 🎨 Design

- **GlimStone 3.0.0** in the web interface, the phone app and the browser extension.
- **The remote access card is one row**: the phrase buttons and the badges side by side, the password warning under them.
- **Each browser gets its own install steps** for the extension, with its extensions page and where its Developer mode switch is.
- **Apps** is the new name of the App tab, and the bookmarklet is a button like the others there.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The torrent upload limit works**, for all torrents together, while they download and while they seed, and a change reaches running torrents at once. It is also in the quick settings.
- **The DHT and PEX switches reach ordinary torrents**, and a new port no longer needs a restart. All three take effect once no torrent is downloading, paused, or seeding, or after a restart.
- **Finished torrents seed again after a restart**, carrying over their upload, ratio and seeding time.
- **Premium only is called Allow free downloads**, and your setting keeps its meaning.
- **Every release carries the browser extension it serves** as `knightloader-extension.zip`.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **KnightLoader no longer crashes when it is stopped right after a torrent starts.**
- **Downloads can be moved and deleted over an Unraid share.** The container takes `UMASK` like linuxserver.io images.
- **The desktop window shows live updates**, and the desktop app knows which release it is.
- **The fold buttons on the Finished and Torrents cards are no longer cut off.**
- **The German installer pages show their umlauts**, and the installer's entry shows the right version.

## 🌐 Translations

- Every new and reworded text in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app.

## 📋 Notes

- Torrents run on a fork of gopeed that adds the upload limit, the DHT and PEX switches and the crash fix. KnightLoader goes back to gopeed itself once it has them.
